title: Faceless Stock — faces that don't exist

versions.body:
Synthetic portraits for when you need a person in the picture and there is no person.

This person does not exist. The licence is ordinary commercial use. You can see two public sample listings without an account:

facelessstock.com/portrait/44812 — #44812 'Executive, 40s, warm'
facelessstock.com/portrait/51007 — #51007 'Mom, 30s, friendly'

The rest of the library is behind a login. Pricing, the licence, and how a file is made are on their own pages.

A single file is a one-off payment, and you keep the licence.

A library login is a monthly plan if you need to browse more than the public samples. The plan does not include a person. There is no person.

We do not do "exclusive faces" as a special product. If a file has been purchased, that is noted on its page.

This page does not take a card. If you already have an account, sign in on the library page.

Unlimited commercial use of the file you paid for, in the usual sense: ads, sites, packaging, presentations.

You may not claim that the person exists, or that they endorse a product. You may not use a file as a substitute for someone's real identity.

The portraits are generated. They are not photographs of residents of this or any other city.

You pick a file, you pay, you download. Tags (executive, friendly, outdoor) are a starting point, not a promise about anyone in particular.

If you want to see what a listing looks like before you have an account, the two public samples are still up:

facelessstock.com/portrait/44812
facelessstock.com/portrait/51007

The full library needs a login. We have not published a complete public grid of every face.
